Candy Clicker is an addictive idle incremental browser and mobile game created by developer Coltroc in Scratch. 
candyclicker.io

Core Gameplay
Clicking: Tap or click the giant candy in the center of the screen to earn individual candy points.
Upgrades: Spend your earned candy in the shop to boost your manual click power or buy passive automatic production (like cursors, farms, and factories).
Golden Candies: Catch rare floating gold candies that cross the screen to trigger massive point bonuses and earn sugar for special upgrades.
Progression: Level up your profile to unlock permanent output multipliers and custom skins in the Sugar Shop.
